name: Reynisfjara & Vík
description: Black sand beach with hexagonal basalt columns (Garðar), sea caves and powerful Atlantic waves. One of the most photogenic beaches on the planet.
source: Film/TV: Rogue One (Lah'mu planet), Game of Thrones (Eastwatch). Video games: Death Stranding, Senua’s Saga: Hellblade II. Competitions: Super Jeep 4x4 and buggy expeditions to Mýrdalsjökull.

name: Þingvellir (Thingvellir)
description: Site of the tectonic fault where the North American and Eurasian plates diverge. UNESCO World Heritage Site and location of the world's first parliament (930 AD).
source: Film/TV: Game of Thrones. Video games: God of War Ragnarök, Hellblade II.

name: Jökulsárlón & Skaftafell
description: Glacial lagoon with blue icebergs floating toward Diamond Beach. Ancient ice formations.
source: Film: James Bond (A View to a Kill, Die Another Day), Lara Croft: Tomb Raider, Interstellar, Batman Begins. Video games: Call of Duty, Asphalt 8.

name: Dettifoss & Mývatn
description: Dettifoss is Europe's most powerful waterfall. Mývatn has craters, geysers, fumaroles and steaming lava.
source: Film: Prometheus (opening), Game of Thrones (Grjótagjá). Video games: Death Stranding. Competitions: Mývatn Marathon.

name: Akureyri & Hlíðarfjall
description: Capital of the North, surrounded by Eyjafjörður fjord. Colorful houses and snow-capped mountains.
source: Film/TV: Nordic productions and extreme action. Competitions: Bíladagar (Motorsport Festival), Formula Off-Road (4x4 with +1000 HP), drag racing and drift at Akureyri Car Club.

name: Skógafoss & Eyjafjallajökull
description: Perfect 60-meter waterfall that creates double rainbows. Nearby Eyjafjallajökull glacier.
source: Film: Thor: The Dark World, The Secret Life of Walter Mitty. Video games: Spirit of the North, Assassin's Creed Valhalla.

name: Kirkjufell & Snæfellsnes
description: Arrowhead-shaped mountain next to Kirkjufellsfoss waterfall. Iconic photographic landmark of Iceland.
source: Film/TV: The Secret Life of Walter Mitty, Game of Thrones. Video games: Virtual travel simulators and adventure maps.

name: Snæfellsjökull
description: Mystical glacier atop a volcano. Entrance to the Center of the Earth.
epic: Entrance to the Center of the Earth
source: Film: Journey to the Center of the Earth (1959). Video games: Exploration adventures.

name: Vatnajökull
source: Game of Thrones / Interstellar. Ice survival video games.

name: Reykjavík
source: The Secret Life of Walter Mitty and modern productions.
